Markets.summary: Indian stock indices closed slightly higher on Friday as gains in financials, metals, and small-caps outweighed losses in IT shares. Analysts expect market volatility to remain high due to crude oil prices, foreign fund flows, and global economic trends.

Markets.title: 20 IPOs on investors' radar next week. GMPs indicate up to 90% returns
Markets.summary: Investors are monitoring 20 upcoming initial public offerings and listings across the mainboard and SME segments next week. Grey market premiums indicate potential listing gains ranging from 56.7% to 107% for top companies like Symbiotec Pharmalab and Tempsens Instruments.

Markets.title: FPIs invest Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities in Aug on earnings revival, rupee stability
Markets.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) invested Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities in August, driven by earnings revival and rupee stability. This inflow follows a heavy selling streak from March through June, during which FPIs withdrew a massive total of Rs 2.60 lakh crore.

Markets.title: Pride Hotels steps up expansion, plans Rs 1,000-cr IPO by December
Markets.summary: Pride Hotels currently operates 40 properties and plans to expand its portfolio to about 72 hotels within the next two years. The hospitality company is also preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) worth Rs 1,000 crore by December.

Markets.title: Mcap of four of top-10 most valued firms erodes Rs 87,960 cr; Airtel takes biggest hit
Markets.summary: Four of India's top ten most valuable firms saw a combined market capitalization erosion of Rs 87,960 crore, with Bharti Airtel taking the biggest hit. Meanwhile, the market valuations of Reliance Industries and Larsen & Toubro increased by Rs 8,119.53 crore and Rs 3,487.83 crore, respectively.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
Geo-Political.summary: After trade talks collapsed, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announced retaliatory tariffs and accused the United States of starting a trade war. In response, Donald Trump claimed that Canada wants the benefits of becoming a U.S. state.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky should be asked what he knew about government corruption, sacked minister tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Sacked Ukrainian minister Mykhailo Fedorov has called for wartime elections to be held in the country. He also stated that President Volodymyr Zelensky should be questioned regarding his knowledge of government corruption.

Geo-Political.title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
Geo-Political.summary: Representatives from the Democratic Republic of Congo and M23 rebels met in Switzerland to negotiate an end to their conflict. Both sides agreed on a roadmap to guide upcoming peace talks.

Geo-Political.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
Geo-Political.summary: Dozens of coordinated arson attacks occurred in southern Thailand, causing widespread unrest. No group has claimed responsibility for the incidents, and the military is currently investigating.

Geo-Political.title: France links rise in drownings to heatwaves
Geo-Political.summary: France has reported 301 drowning deaths since June 19. A government minister stated that the rise in fatalities is linked to people taking risks in the water during heatwaves.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands struggling without power in Indiana 12 days after severe storms
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of residents in Indiana remain without power 12 days after severe storms hit the area. In Gary, where a third of the population lives in poverty, residents report living in survival mode due to the prolonged outage.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights recent Mint reports featuring easy-to-read charts on key economic and environmental issues. The topics covered include hawkish Reserve Bank of India minutes, a drought warning, and trends in the rural workforce.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments across various sectors under eased norms for land-border countries. However, the origin of these investments remains unclear regarding whether they come from China.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could reach nearly 7%, surpassing the central bank's previous 6.7% forecast. This optimistic outlook is driven by stronger-than-expected economic indicators, leading markets to anticipate a potential interest rate hike later this year.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector growth likely accelerated in August, according to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey. This advance estimate provides an early indication of positive shifts in the country's economic sentiment and output.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Fearing that ethanol-blended E20 petrol reduces mileage and harms engine life, consumers are increasingly buying premium, high-octane fuel. This trend has driven premium petrol's sales share from about 4% in March to 12-15%.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has eliminated import duties on sugar to reduce record-high domestic prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

India.title: Pakistan Rebuilds Jaish Headquarters Destroyed During Operation Sindoor
India.summary: The Markaz Subhanallah complex in Pakistan, which was badly damaged during India's Operation Sindoor precision strikes last year, has been extensively rebuilt. This sprawling facility serves as the headquarters for the Jaish group.

India.title: 'You Ruined My Family': Teen's Mother's Old Video Surfaces After Hill Suicide
India.summary: An old video of a teenager's mother has surfaced following his suicide at a hill in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra. Sources reported that Kunal had previously attempted suicide at the exact same location a year ago.

India.title: Several Detained At Delhi's Connaught Place Over Anti-Reservation Protests
India.summary: Several people were detained during an anti-reservation protest at Connaught Place in Delhi. The demonstrators marched with placards and slogans, demanding that economic criteria be prioritized for government support and reservation eligibility.

India.title: India Cuts The Cord On Imports, Test-Fires Fully Indigenous AK-203 "Sher"
India.summary: India has successfully test-fired the "Sher," a fully indigenous AK-203 assault rifle. The rifle was manufactured by Indo-Russian Rifles Private Limited, a joint venture established in 2019 to produce these weapons domestically and reduce import reliance.

India.title: Ex-Andhra Minister Karumuri Nageswara Rao Arrested In Alleged Liquor Scam
India.summary: Former Andhra Pradesh minister Karumuri Venkata Nageswara Rao has been arrested in connection with a liquor scam. The Telugu Desam Party (TDP)-led coalition government has defended the arrest against accusations of political vendetta.

India.title: Body Parts Were Found On Train. This Chennai House Held More Secrets
